name: RADIOTHERAPY_RECORD_INFO
description: This table contains no add summary information for External Radiation Therapy Treatment Data records.

columns.name: RT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the radiotherapy summary record.

columns.name: CM_PHY_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this record or line. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: CM_LOG_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance from which this record or line was extracted. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS_2_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the record status (hidden, soft-deleted, etc...)

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: Stores the patient being treated or planned to be treated by the radiotherapy summary.

columns.name: RADIOTHERAPY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the type of the record.

columns.name: RECORD_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Stores the date the record was created
